notes.title: Into the Waves is now released!
notes.content:
Initially Into the Waves was made for a visual novel game jam in 10 days. We polished up the experience, translated it into English and brought it to Steam with a DLC for those who want to support us. Please consider buying it if you enjoyed the work. And we certainly do hope that you'll like this story. Updates on our other projects will follow later.

Man, releasing a game about sun and ocean in the winter feels great. 

Happy new year!
